Created the self-contained HTML file with a Gouraud-shaded rotating cube using Canvas 2D only. The implementation includes:

- Minimal 3D pipeline: vertices array, rotation matrices (X, Y, Z), perspective projection with field of view 400 and near/far planes.
- Backface culling using face normals and view direction dot product.
- Face splitting into two triangles for each cube face.
- Per-vertex Lambert lighting with diffuse and specular components.
- Gouraud shading via color interpolation across rasterized pixels using barycentric coordinates.
- Animated moving light source orbiting around the cube.
- Keyboard controls: 'W' toggles wireframe overlay, 'P' pauses/resumes rotation.
- Real-time FPS display in the UI.

The file is ready to open in any modern browser.
